results.name: A box from “The Crown” pharmacy in Kraków
results.description:
The presented cardboard packaging for medicines from 1913 was produced by Fabryka Pudełek Pacanowski Jan (Jan Pacanowski’s Box Factory) located at 20 Grzegórzecka Street in Kraków. The box comes from the “Pod Koroną” pharmacy, which operated on the Main Square in Kraków. It consists of two parts: the part for storing medicines and the lid with a decorative label. At the top of the label, the pharmacy’s emblem is placed: a golden crown held up by two angels. An inscription around it says: “Apteka pod Koroną w Krakowie. Fr.(anciszka) Ksaw.(erego) Mikuckiego” (Franciszek Ksawery Mikucki’s The Crown Pharmacy in Kraków).

ID no.: Teka 10/180

Time of creation: 1913

Museum: The Museum of Pharmacy at the Jagiellonian University Medical College in Kraków

https://muzea.malopolska.pl/en/objects-list/1758

Digitalisation: RDW MIC, Virtual Małopolska project

results.name: Box for effervescent bath tablets
results.description:
The presented metal box for effervescent bath tablets was manufactured by the Fabkryka Chemiczno-Farmaceutyczna Dr. A. Wander S.A. (Chemical-Pharmaceutical Factory Dr. A. Wander Inc.), which was located at 80 Mogilska Street in Kraków.
The composition of the effervescent tablets is unspecified; however, it is known that such substances intended for bathing contained potassium carbonate, sulfur, sodium chloride, and often also the root of calamus (Acorus calamus L.), chamomile flower (Matricaria chamomilla L.) and numerous essential oils.

ID no.: KGZ 8754

Time and place of creation: interwar period (after 1918), Kraków, Poland

Museum: The Museum of Pharmacy at the Jagiellonian University Medical College in Kraków

https://muzea.malopolska.pl/en/objects-list/1765

Digitalisation: RDW MIC, Virtual Małopolska project
